messages:
Elena: Quick request to runtime for launch collateral. We need validated bench artifacts for the 'spring-launch' cohort. TL;DR: smoke (200) in 4h, full (800) in 24h. Deliverables: per-sample CSV, per-token timing traces, p50/p95 cold vs warm, KV cache hit rate, and a 1-slide summary.

Marcus: Got it. Which model/commit and exact payloads? Also what quant variants?

Elena: Model: redwood-serve/2.1-medium@c3d2a. Payloads: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/spring-launch/manifest.json (seed=999). Variants: fp16 baseline, int8 quant. Tag artifacts: campaign=spring2026, cohort=spring-launch-v2. Retention: raw logs 21d.

Jo: Add hallucination flag: we have a refs file at s3://.../refs.json. Mark boolean if similarity <0.8. Also include a small delta table showing which samples changed between fp16 and int8.

Marcus: We'll run warmup protocol: short=3 warmup calls, long=8. We'll report warm vs cold percentiles and include warmup protocol text in metadata. If cluster busy, smoke fallback=200 samples.

Ops Bot: Scheduling jobs now. Queued ids: run-20260505-1101 (fp16 smoke), run-20260505-1102 (int8 smoke). Full jobs queued after smoke. ETA smoke ~3.5h.

Runtime Bot: Run started: run-20260505-1101 @ 1753219900. Upload: s3://redwood-internal/runs/run-20260505-1101/. Please confirm any extra trace keys.

Elena: Please capture per-request fields: sample_id, origin_path, prompt_len, resp_len, latency_ms, token_timings, kv_cache_hits, hallucination_flag, variant. Also a summary csv with p50/p95 cold/warm by length bucket.

Jo: If int8 shows >15% p95 regression vs fp16, flag for ops review and include representative traces.

Marcus: Understood. Will post artifacts + 1-slide summary when smoke completes. :thumbsup:
